name: b2b-sales-enablement
description: Sales enablement skills for B2B teams by Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting, to decide how to win against a competitor and present your offer: competitive intelligence, meeting prep and debrief, and client proposal decks.

plugins.name: b2b-sales-enablement
plugins.description: For B2B sellers, founders and sales leaders: decide how to win against a named competitor, what to know before a meeting, and how to present your offer to one client. Give it the competitor, the meeting or the prospect; get battle cards, a meeting brief and debrief, or a client deck or proposal in the client's own brand style.
